name: task-management-dashboard
description: Real-Time Collaborative Task Management Dashboard — Angular + GraphQL reference architecture

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.ci: npm run ci:server && npm run ci:client
